segments.mn30:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.mn30:2.1: Atha kho piṅgalakoccho brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.mn30:2.2: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho piṅgalakoccho brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn30:2.3: “yeme, bho gotama, samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā, bahujanassa, seyyathidaṃ – pūraṇo kassapo, makkhali gosālo, ajito kesakambalo, pakudho kaccāyano, sañcayo [sañjayo (sī. syā. pī. ka.)] belaṭṭhaputto, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto, sabbete sakāya paṭiññāya abbhaññaṃsu sabbeva nābbhaññaṃsu, udāhu ekacce abbhaññaṃsu ekacce nābbhaññaṃsū”ti?
segments.mn30:2.6: “Alaṃ, brāhmaṇa, tiṭṭhatetaṃ – sabbete sakāya paṭiññāya abbhaññaṃsu sabbeva nābbhaññaṃsu, udāhu ekacce abbhaññaṃsu ekacce nābbhaññaṃsūti.
segments.mn30:2.8: Dhammaṃ te, brāhmaṇa, desessāmi, taṃ suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi, bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.mn30:2.10: “Evaṃ, bho”ti kho piṅgalakoccho brāhmaṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
segments.mn30:3.1: “Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato atikkammeva sāraṃ atikkamma phegguṃ atikkamma tacaṃ atikkamma papaṭikaṃ, sākhāpalāsaṃ chetvā ādāya pakkameyya ‘sāran’ti maññamāno.
segments.mn30:3.2: Tamenaṃ cakkhumā puriso disvā evaṃ vadeyya –
segments.mn30:3.3: ‘na vatāyaṃ bhavaṃ puriso aññāsi sāraṃ, na aññāsi phegguṃ, na aññāsi tacaṃ, na aññāsi papaṭikaṃ, na aññāsi sākhāpalāsaṃ.
segments.mn30:3.4: Tathā hayaṃ bhavaṃ puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato atikkammeva sāraṃ atikkamma phegguṃ atikkamma tacaṃ atikkamma papaṭikaṃ, sākhāpalāsaṃ chetvā ādāya pakkanto ‘sāran’ti maññamāno.
segments.mn30:3.5: Yañcassa sārena sārakaraṇīyaṃ tañcassa atthaṃ nānubhavissatī’ti.

segments.mn30:7.1: “Seyyathāpi vā pana, brāhmaṇa, puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato sāraññeva chetvā ādāya pakkameyya ‘sāran’ti jānamāno.
segments.mn30:7.2: Tamenaṃ cakkhumā puriso disvā evaṃ vadeyya –
segments.mn30:7.3: ‘aññāsi vatāyaṃ bhavaṃ puriso sāraṃ, aññāsi phegguṃ, aññāsi tacaṃ, aññāsi papaṭikaṃ, aññāsi sākhāpalāsaṃ.
segments.mn30:7.4: Tathā hayaṃ bhavaṃ puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato sāraññeva chetvā ādāya pakkanto ‘sāran’ti jānamāno.
segments.mn30:7.5: Yañcassa sārena sārakaraṇīyaṃ tañcassa atthaṃ anubhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn30:8.1: “Evameva kho, brāhmaṇa, idhekacco puggalo saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti –
segments.mn30:8.2: ‘otiṇṇomhi jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto, appeva nāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā’ti.
segments.mn30:8.4: So evaṃ pabbajito samāno lābhasakkārasilokaṃ abhinibbatteti.
segments.mn30:8.5: So tena lābhasakkārasilokena attamano hoti paripuṇṇasaṅkappo.
segments.mn30:8.6: So tena lābhasakkārasilokena attānukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti –
segments.mn30:8.7: ‘ahamasmi lābhasakkārasilokavā, ime panaññe bhikkhū appaññātā appesakkhā’ti.
segments.mn30:8.8: Lābhasakkārasilokena ca ye aññe dhammā uttaritarā ca paṇītatarā ca tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sacchikiriyāya na chandaṃ janeti, na vāyamati, olīnavuttiko ca hoti sāthaliko.
segments.mn30:8.9: Seyyathāpi so, brāhmaṇa, puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato atikkammeva sāraṃ atikkamma phegguṃ atikkamma tacaṃ atikkamma papaṭikaṃ, sākhāpalāsaṃ chetvā ādāya pakkanto ‘sāran’ti maññamāno.
segments.mn30:8.10: Yañcassa sārena sārakaraṇīyaṃ tañcassa atthaṃ nānubhavissati.
segments.mn30:9.1: “Idha pana, brāhmaṇa, ekacco puggalo saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti –
segments.mn30:9.2: ‘otiṇṇomhi jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto, appeva nāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā’ti.
segments.mn30:9.4: So evaṃ pabbajito samāno lābhasakkārasilokaṃ abhinibbatteti.
segments.mn30:9.5: So tena lābhasakkārasilokena na attamano hoti na paripuṇṇasaṅkappo.
segments.mn30:9.6: So tena lābhasakkārasilokena na attānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn30:9.7: Lābhasakkārasilokena ca ye aññe dhammā uttaritarā ca paṇītatarā ca tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sacchikiriyāya chandaṃ janeti, vāyamati, anolīnavuttiko ca hoti asāthaliko.
segments.mn30:9.9: So tāya sīlasampadāya attamano hoti, paripuṇṇasaṅkappo.
segments.mn30:9.10: So tāya sīlasampadāya attānukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti –
segments.mn30:9.11: ‘ahamasmi sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo, ime panaññe bhikkhū dussīlā pāpadhammā’ti.
segments.mn30:9.12: Sīlasampadāya ca ye aññe dhammā uttaritarā ca paṇītatarā ca tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sacchikiriyāya na chandaṃ janeti, na vāyamati, olīnavuttiko ca hoti sāthaliko.
segments.mn30:9.13: Seyyathāpi so, brāhmaṇa, puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato atikkammeva sāraṃ atikkamma phegguṃ atikkamma tacaṃ, papaṭikaṃ chetvā ādāya pakkanto ‘sāran’ti maññamāno.
segments.mn30:9.14: Yañcassa sārena sārakaraṇīyaṃ, tañcassa atthaṃ nānubhavissati.
segments.mn30:10.1: “Idha pana, brāhmaṇa, ekacco puggalo saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti –
segments.mn30:10.2: ‘otiṇṇomhi jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto, appeva nāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā’ti.
segments.mn30:10.4: So evaṃ pabbajito samāno lābhasakkārasilokaṃ abhinibbatteti.
segments.mn30:10.5: So tena lābhasakkārasilokena na attamano hoti, na paripuṇṇasaṅkappo.
segments.mn30:10.6: So tena lābhasakkārasilokena na attānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn30:10.7: Lābhasakkārasilokena ca ye aññe dhammā uttaritarā ca paṇītatarā ca tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sacchikiriyāya chandaṃ janeti, vāyamati, anolīnavuttiko ca hoti asāthaliko.

segments.mn30:10.11: Sīlasampadāya ca ye aññe dhammā uttaritarā ca paṇītatarā ca tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sacchikiriyāya chandaṃ janeti, vāyamati, anolīnavuttiko ca hoti asāthaliko.
segments.mn30:10.13: So tāya samādhisampadāya attamano hoti, paripuṇṇasaṅkappo.
segments.mn30:10.14: So tāya samādhisampadāya attānukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti –
segments.mn30:10.15: ‘ahamasmi samāhito ekaggacitto, ime panaññe bhikkhū asamāhitā vibbhantacittā’ti.
segments.mn30:10.16: Samādhisampadāya ca ye aññe dhammā uttaritarā ca paṇītatarā ca, tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sacchikiriyāya na chandaṃ janeti, na vāyamati, olīnavuttiko ca hoti sāthaliko.
segments.mn30:10.17: Seyyathāpi so, brāhmaṇa, puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato atikkammeva sāraṃ atikkamma phegguṃ, tacaṃ chetvā ādāya pakkanto ‘sāran’ti maññamāno.
segments.mn30:10.18: Yañcassa sārena sārakaraṇīyaṃ tañcassa atthaṃ nānubhavissati.
segments.mn30:11.1: “Idha pana, brāhmaṇa, ekacco puggalo saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti –
segments.mn30:11.2: ‘otiṇṇomhi jātiyā jarāya maraṇena … pe … antakiriyā paññāyethā’ti.
segments.mn30:11.4: So evaṃ pabbajito samāno lābhasakkārasilokaṃ abhinibbatteti.
segments.mn30:11.5: So tena lābhasakkārasilokena na attamano hoti na paripuṇṇasaṅkappo.
segments.mn30:11.6: So tena lābhasakkārasilokena na attānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn30:11.7: Lābhasakkārasilokena ca ye aññe dhammā uttaritarā ca paṇītatarā ca tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sacchikiriyāya chandaṃ janeti, vāyamati, anolīnavuttiko ca hoti asāthaliko.
segments.mn30:11.9: So tāya sīlasampadāya attamano hoti, no ca kho paripuṇṇasaṅkappo.
segments.mn30:11.10: So tāya sīlasampadāya na attānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn30:11.11: Sīlasampadāya ca ye aññe dhammā uttaritarā ca paṇītatarā ca tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sacchikiriyāya chandaṃ janeti, vāyamati, anolīnavuttiko ca hoti asāthaliko.
segments.mn30:11.13: So tāya samādhisampadāya attamano hoti, no ca kho paripuṇṇasaṅkappo.
segments.mn30:11.14: So tāya samādhisampadāya na attānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn30:11.15: Samādhisampadāya ca ye aññe dhammā uttaritarā ca paṇītatarā ca tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sacchikiriyāya chandaṃ janeti, vāyamati, anolīnavuttiko ca hoti asāthaliko.
segments.mn30:11.17: So tena ñāṇadassanena attamano hoti, paripuṇṇasaṅkappo.
segments.mn30:11.18: So tena ñāṇadassanena attānukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti –
segments.mn30:11.19: ‘ahamasmi jānaṃ passaṃ viharāmi, ime panaññe bhikkhū ajānaṃ apassaṃ viharantī’ti.
segments.mn30:11.20: Ñāṇadassanena ca ye aññe dhammā uttaritarā ca paṇītatarā ca tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sacchikiriyāya na chandaṃ janeti, na vāyamati, olīnavuttiko ca hoti sāthaliko.
segments.mn30:11.21: Seyyathāpi so, brāhmaṇa, puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato atikkammeva sāraṃ, phegguṃ chetvā ādāya pakkanto ‘sāran’ti maññamāno.
segments.mn30:11.22: Yañcassa sārena sārakaraṇīyaṃ tañcassa atthaṃ nānubhavissati.

segments.mn30:12.2: ‘otiṇṇomhi jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto, appeva nāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā’ti.

segments.mn30:12.14: So tāya samādhisampadāya na attānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.

segments.mn30:12.17: So tena ñāṇadassanena attamano hoti, no ca kho paripuṇṇasaṅkappo.
segments.mn30:12.18: So tena ñāṇadassanena na attānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn30:12.19: Ñāṇadassanena ca ye aññe dhammā uttaritarā ca paṇītatarā ca tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sacchikiriyāya chandaṃ janeti, vāyamati, anolīnavuttiko ca hoti asāthaliko.
segments.mn30:12.20: “Katame ca, brāhmaṇa, dhammā ñāṇadassanena uttaritarā ca paṇītatarā ca?
segments.mn30:13.1: Idha, brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.mn30:13.2: Ayampi kho, brāhmaṇa, dhammo ñāṇadassanena uttaritaro ca paṇītataro ca.
segments.mn30:14.1: “Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.mn30:14.2: Ayampi kho, brāhmaṇa, dhammo ñāṇadassanena uttaritaro ca paṇītataro ca.
segments.mn30:15.1: “Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati, sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti, yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti – ‘upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī’ti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.mn30:15.2: Ayampi kho, brāhmaṇa, dhammo ñāṇadassanena uttaritaro ca paṇītataro ca.
segments.mn30:16.1: “Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.mn30:16.2: Ayampi kho, brāhmaṇa, dhammo ñāṇadassanena uttaritaro ca paṇītataro ca.
segments.mn30:17.1: “Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘ananto ākāso’ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.mn30:17.2: Ayampi kho, brāhmaṇa, dhammo ñāṇadassanena uttaritaro ca paṇītataro ca.
segments.mn30:18.1: “Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇan’ti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.mn30:18.2: Ayampi kho, brāhmaṇa, dhammo ñāṇadassanena uttaritaro ca paṇītataro ca.
segments.mn30:19.1: “Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘natthi kiñcī’ti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.mn30:19.2: Ayampi kho, brāhmaṇa, dhammo ñāṇadassanena uttaritaro ca paṇītataro ca.
segments.mn30:20.1: “Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.mn30:20.2: Ayampi kho, brāhmaṇa, dhammo ñāṇadassanena uttaritaro ca paṇītataro ca.
segments.mn30:21.1: “Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati, paññāya cassa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti.
segments.mn30:21.2: Ayampi kho, brāhmaṇa, dhammo ñāṇadassanena uttaritaro ca paṇītataro ca.
segments.mn30:21.3: Ime kho, brāhmaṇa, dhammā ñāṇadassanena uttaritarā ca paṇītatarā ca.
segments.mn30:22.1: “Seyyathāpi so, brāhmaṇa, puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato sāraṃyeva chetvā ādāya pakkanto ‘sāran’ti jānamāno.
segments.mn30:22.2: Yañcassa sārena sārakaraṇīyaṃ tañcassa atthaṃ anubhavissati.
segments.mn30:23.1: “Iti kho, brāhmaṇa, nayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ lābhasakkārasilokānisaṃsaṃ, na sīlasampadānisaṃsaṃ, na samādhisampadānisaṃsaṃ, na ñāṇadassanānisaṃsaṃ.
segments.mn30:23.2: Yā ca kho ayaṃ, brāhmaṇa, akuppā cetovimutti – etadatthamidaṃ, brāhmaṇa, brahmacariyaṃ, etaṃ sāraṃ etaṃ pariyosānan”ti.
segments.mn30:24.1: Evaṃ vutte, piṅgalakoccho brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn30:24.2: “abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama, abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama … pe … upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan”ti.

lines: “Appicchā santuṭṭhā, appicchatāya vatthampi na nivāsentī”tiādinā nayena samuggato yaso etesaṃ atthīti yasassino.
Sādhusammatāti ime sādhu sundarā sappurisāti evaṃ sammatā.
So kira aññatarassa kulassa ekūnadāsasataṃ pūrayamāno jāto, tenassa “pūraṇo”ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu.
Maṅgaladāsattā cassa “dukkaṭan”ti vattā natthi, akataṃ vā na katanti.
So paṇṇena vā tiṇena vā paṭicchādetumpi ajānanto jātarūpeneva ekaṃ gāmaṃ pāvisi.
Manussā taṃ disvā,“ayaṃ samaṇo arahā appiccho, natthi iminā sadiso”ti pūvabhattādīni gahetvā upasaṅkamanti.
So “mayhaṃ sāṭakaṃ anivatthabhāvena idaṃ uppannan”ti tato paṭṭhāya sāṭakaṃ labhitvāpi na nivāsesi, tadeva pabbajjaṃ aggahesi.
Tassa santike aññepi pañcasatā manussā pabbajiṃsu, taṃ sandhāyāha “pūraṇo kassapo”ti.
Taṃ kira sakaddamāya bhūmiyā telaghaṭaṃ gahetvā gacchantaṃ,“tāta, mā khalī”ti sāmiko āha.
So pamādena khalitvā patitvā sāmikassa bhayena palāyituṃ āraddho.
Sopi sāṭakaṃ chaḍḍetvā acelako hutvā palāyi, sesaṃ pūraṇasadisameva.
Tattha kesakambalo nāma manussakesehi katakambalo, tato paṭikiṭṭhataraṃ vatthaṃ nāma natthi.
“seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici tantāvutānaṃ vatthānaṃ, kesakambalo tesaṃ paṭikiṭṭho akkhāyati, kesakambalo, bhikkhave, sīte sīto uṇhe uṇho dubbaṇṇo duggandho dukkhasamphasso”ti (a. ni.3.138).

Sītudakapaṭikkhittako esa, vaccaṃ katvāpi udakakiccaṃ na karoti, uṇhodakaṃ vā kañjiyaṃ vā labhitvā karoti, nadiṃ vā maggodakaṃ vā atikkamma,“sīlaṃ me bhinnan”ti vālikathūpaṃ katvā sīlaṃ adhiṭṭhāya gacchati, evarūpo nissirikaladdhiko esa.
Amhākaṃ gaṇṭhanakileso palibujjhanakileso natthi, kilesagaṇṭharahitā mayanti evaṃ vāditāya laddhanāmavasena nigaṇṭho.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – sace nesaṃ sā paṭiññā niyyānikā sabbe abbhaññaṃsu.
Tasmā kiṃ tesaṃ paṭiññā niyyānikā na niyyānikāti, ayametassa pañhassa attho.
Atha bhagavā nesaṃ aniyyānikabhāvakathanena atthābhāvato alanti paṭikkhipitvā upamāya atthaṃ pavedento dhammameva desetuṃ, dhammaṃ, te brāhmaṇa, desessāmīti āha.
Sāthalikoti sithilaggāhī, sāsanaṃ sithilaṃ katvā gaṇhāti, daḷhaṃ na gaṇhāti.
Idha, brāhmaṇa bhikkhu, vivicceva kāmehīti kathaṃ ime paṭhamajjhānādidhammā ñāṇadassanena uttaritarā jātāti?
Heṭṭhā paṭhamajjhānādidhammā hi vipassanāpādakā, idha nirodhapādakā, tasmā uttaritarā jātāti veditabbā.
Iti bhagavā idampi suttaṃ yathānusandhināva niṭṭhapesi.
Paññātāti yathāsakaṃ samādinnavatavasena ceva viññātaladdhivasena ca paññātā.
Tassa pana āgamasampadāpi nāma natthi, kuto adhigamoti ekaṃsato andhaputhujjano evāti āha “assutavato andhabālaputhujjanassā”ti.
Evaṃ vāditāyāti evaṃ paṭiññatāya, evaṃ diṭṭhitāya vā.
Tesaṃ sabbaññupaṭiññāya abhūtattā tassā abhūtabhāvakathanena tassa brāhmaṇassa na kāci atthasiddhīti āha “nesaṃ aniyyānikabhāvakathanena atthābhāvato”ti.
Nihīnalokāmise līno ajjhāsayo etassa, na pana nibbāneti.
Sāsanaṃ sithilaṃ katvā gaṇhāti sikkhāya na tibbagāravattā.
Nirodhapādakāti anāgāmino, arahanto vā nirodhasamāpattiṃ samāpajjituṃ samatthā.
